generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a small, slow, often crooked understory tree with long, drooping branches and flat sprays of soft, pointed needles. Not fitted to measurements. Cones (plant forms F3): seeds in a red fleshy aril about 8 mm; set from general knowledge of the species, not measured.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 9 m tall and 25 cm across at breast height at 80 years in a closed stand. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: dark yellowish-green needles; thin, scaly, reddish-purple bark.

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy from the step-6 catalogue, authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands. Calibration against measurements and photographs is milestone P4.
